correctness.rationale: Represent a plane by a rank-two 2×n basis matrix; each adjacent determinant vanishes iff neighboring nonzero vertex columns occupy the same projective line. For support S with c components the number of rank-two ordered matrices is (q-1)^|S|((q+1)^c-(q+1)); subtract zero-support correction and divide by |GL_2(q)|. The cyclic occupancy transfer has characteristic polynomial lambda^2-(1+w)lambda-qw and a correction qw^n for all occupied; eigenvalue dominance near w=q-1 yields quasi-powers and a CLT with the claimed nonzero variance coefficient. Independent canonical-RREF enumeration for q=2 n=4,5,6 and q=3 n=4 matched direct induced-component predictions; independent symbolic derivatives for q=2,3,5,9 matched mu and sigma². Group equivalence is restricted to odd prime fields and subgroups containing G'.
